reviewed_by: Claude review of the pre-existing interface failures on main, three layout bugs they exposed, the Missions toolbar overlap and a streaming scroll race
reason: Product fixes: the Workbench top bar clipped the Tool assistance menu and scrolled itself when a control inside received focus (now clips horizontally only); the phone code-editor sidebar collapsed the changed-files list behind its footer (now scrolls as a whole); the Missions 'Automate task' toolbar shortcut rendered as a 44px square with an overflowing label (now icon-only like its neighbours); and a reader scrolling up during a streamed reply could be pulled back to the bottom because content growth outranked the upward move (now an upward move is always reader intent, with a unit test). Test repairs: connected-harness fixtures declare authentication_state verified (required since #311) except the provider-focused ones; the default mock serves an automation policy so Project Policy loads; stale geometry limits follow the 44px top-bar contract; the code editor journey opens the More editor tools overflow and focuses the editor without clicking under fixed phone navigation; the completed-harness journey mocks the durable transcript and turn events that Workbench now reloads; a status locator is scoped; three screenshot baselines of removed layouts were regenerated after visual review. Catalogued assistant, stabilization, themes and desktop-shell groups now pass locally (previously 14/9/22 failures on main); editor-files-scroll and coding-makeover guard the phone sidebar change. Frontend tests cover the scroll rule, code editor, mission controls, App and post-tool assistance.
exclusions: No full suites. The code editor journey still very rarely shows Ln 1, Col 1 in the narrow project under heavy parallel load (1 of about 22 runs); not selected in CI. Physical devices and the desktop Tauri window were not exercised.
